start.title: New session

key.label: OpenAI API key
key.help: Stays in this browser and goes straight to OpenAI.
key.invalid: That doesn't look like an OpenAI key. It starts with “sk-”.
key.azureHelp: The key from your resource’s “Keys and Endpoint” page. Stays in this browser and goes straight to your resource.
key.azureInvalid: That doesn't look like an Azure OpenAI key.

endpoint.label: Azure OpenAI endpoint
endpoint.help: The resource endpoint from “Keys and Endpoint”. In the settings, the model names must be your deployment names.
endpoint.invalid: That doesn't look like an Azure OpenAI endpoint (https://<resource>.openai.azure.com).

start.tabHint: Pick the tab or screen with the call and tick “Share audio” — that’s all @:{'brand.name'} hears.
start.micHint: Allow the microphone when the browser asks.
start.mixedHint: Pick the call’s tab and tick “Share audio”, then allow the microphone.

tab.name: A tab
tab.for: Calls, videos and webinars on your computer
tab.hint: Share the tab or screen with the call or video. What is said in your room is not heard.

mic.name: Microphone
mic.for: Meeting rooms, interviews, conversations and events
mic.hint: Listens to what is said around you. Keep the microphone close to whoever speaks, or use an external one: the further away, the worse it understands. Let the people present know they are being transcribed.

mixed.name: Both
mixed.for: Hybrid meetings: people on the call and in the room
mixed.hint: Mixes the call’s tab with the room’s microphone. Wear headphones so the microphone doesn’t pick up the call twice. Let the people present know they are being transcribed.

where.heading: Where to see the captions

floating.name: Floating window
floating.for: Above the call and every other window, even outside the browser

page.name: In the app
page.for: Everything in this tab: captions, synced picture and settings

hint.floating: The captions open in a floating window. You can bring them into the app at any time.
hint.page: The captions show on this page. You can float them above other windows at any time.

where.unavailable: This browser can’t open floating windows, so the captions show on this page.

install.title: Install @:{'brand.name'} on your phone
install.why: It opens from your home screen, full screen.
install.ios: In Safari, tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.

demo.note: Translated captions only, no account and no key. Speak, or play a video, and watch it in your language.

overlay.slow: The translation is running behind; it catches up by joining sentences
overlay.resize: Drag to resize (or use the arrow keys)
overlay.hiddenHint: The captions are hidden. To show them again:

source.label: Original text
source.hint: What they say, under the translation

voice.label: Hear the translation
voice.hint: A voice reads it to you

suggestions.label: Reply suggestions
suggestions.hint: What to answer, in your language and theirs

questions.label: Questions to ask
questions.hint: Ideas to ask about or dig into, in your language and theirs

summary.label: Live summary
summary.hint: Key points as it goes on

look.title: Appearance
look.resizeHint: Drag the edges of the bar to resize it.

glossary.label: Names and terms
glossary.placeholder: One per line: Acme, Kubernetes, Kenji Watanabe…

suggestions.title: You could reply
suggestions.empty: They appear when you're asked a question.

questions.title: You could ask
questions.empty: They appear every few sentences, from what is explained.

summary.title: Summary
summary.empty: Fills up as it goes on.

cost.label: ≈ {cost} this session
cost.limitHint: The session stops when it gets there. Based on the estimate.
cost.hint: Estimate from token usage; your OpenAI bill is what counts.
cost.unknown: not available (a model has no known price)
cost.billed: Audio billed: {sent} of {heard} heard; the silence stayed on your device.
cost.nearLimit: The session has used 80% of its spending limit.
cost.unpricedLimit: A model in use has no known price, so the estimate and the spending limit can't count it.

quality.title: Quality
quality.interpreterHint: Translates while they speak, in its own voice. No glossary.
quality.custom: Custom models in use; pick a level to replace them.

voice.title: Voice
voice.sample: Hello, this is how the translations of your meeting will sound.
voice.sampleFailed: The sample could not be played. Check your key.
voice.needsKey: Enter your OpenAI key to hear the voices
voice.cost: OpenAI voices are billed to your key (≈ $0.45/h); the browser voice is free.
voice.interpreter: In Interpreter mode the translation model speaks with its own voice.

meeting.label: About the meeting
meeting.hint: Topic and languages, for a better transcript
meeting.note: Applies when the next session starts. With no languages, any is detected.

sound.title: Sound
sound.screenShared: The original audio can only be adjusted when sharing a tab; with the whole screen it plays as usual.

startOver.label: Start over
startOver.hint: Clears the captions and voices; the session goes on

sync.label: Picture in step with the captions
sync.hint: Shows the shared tab in the app a few seconds behind, so each caption lands on its sentence
sync.on: Watch the tab in step with the captions
sync.unavailable: Only works when sharing a Chrome tab with its audio; not with a window or the whole screen

errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.validation: Please check the data you entered.
errors.unsupported: Your browser doesn't support this feature.
errors.pipUnsupported: This browser can’t open the floating window or share tabs. Choose “Microphone”: the captions will show on this page.
errors.service: The translation service isn't responding. Please try again.
errors.captureUnsupported: Your browser can't capture audio. Use Chrome or Edge on a computer.
errors.shareCancelled: Sharing was cancelled. Press Start and choose a tab or screen.
errors.noAudio: No audio was shared. Try again and tick “Share audio” in the dialog.
errors.audioEnded: Sharing stopped, so @:{'brand.name'} can't hear anything any more.
errors.captureFailed: The audio couldn't be captured. Please try again.
errors.invalidKey: OpenAI rejected the key. Check it and try again.
errors.rateLimited: OpenAI is limiting requests right now. Translation will resume in a moment.
errors.connectionFailed: Couldn't connect to OpenAI. Check your connection and try again.
errors.connectionLost: The connection to OpenAI was lost. Press Start to continue.
errors.interpreterAzure: Interpreter mode works with OpenAI only, not Azure. Pick another quality level.
errors.spendLimit: The session reached your spending limit and stopped. Raise it in the settings to go on.
errors.noCredit: Your OpenAI account has no credit left. Add credit in your OpenAI billing settings and start again.
errors.ttsFailed: The OpenAI voice failed, so your browser's voice is reading instead.
errors.invalidEndpoint: That Azure endpoint isn't valid. Check it on the home page.
errors.deploymentNotFound: Azure has no deployment with that name. Check the model names in settings: they must match your deployments.
errors.modelNotFound: OpenAI has no model with that name, or your key can’t use it. Check the model names in settings.
errors.badSettings: OpenAI rejected the request settings. Check the model names in settings, or pick a quality level.
errors.sessionFile: That file is not a @:{'brand.name'} conversation, or it is damaged.
errors.sessionFileVersion: That conversation was saved by a newer @:{'brand.name'}. Reload the page and try again.
errors.micUnsupported: Your browser can’t use the microphone. Try an up-to-date Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox.
errors.micDenied: Microphone access was not allowed. Allow it from the icon in the address bar and start again.
errors.noMic: No microphone was found. Plug one in and start again.
errors.micBusy: The microphone is in use by another app or failed. Close that app or pick another microphone.
errors.micEnded: The microphone was disconnected, so @:{'brand.name'} can’t hear anything any more.
errors.awayResumed: It stopped hearing while you were out of the app, so some of what was said may be missing. It is listening again.
errors.awayPaused: The microphone paused when you left the app and has not come back. Start again to carry on.
errors.demoEnded: The 3-minute demo is over. Add your OpenAI key to keep going, from ≈ $0.24 an hour.
errors.demoQuota: No more free demos today. Add your OpenAI key to keep going.
errors.demoUnavailable: The free demo is not available right now. Try again later, or use your own key.

live.tabSilent: No sound is coming from what you shared. If it is a video, press play in its tab.

notice.tab: Listening to the audio you shared.
notice.mixed: Listening to the tab you shared and the microphone.

where.floating: Translations appear in the floating window about a second after each sentence.
where.page: Translations appear here about a second after each sentence.

live.tip: Tip: the floating window stays on top of every other window, even outside the browser. Drag it by its title bar and resize it from its edges.
live.pageTip: Keep this tab in view: a second monitor, or the picture in step with the captions, lets you follow the call and read at once. The screen stays on meanwhile.
live.micPageTip: Leave the phone or laptop where you can read it at a glance: the screen stays on while you listen.
live.roomTip: In a room: keep the microphone close to whoever speaks and away from fans or projectors. Remember to tell the people present that they are being transcribed.

open.title: Your captions are in the floating window
open.text: It stays on top of everything: put it where it doesn’t get in the way and go back to your call. Bring the captions back here whenever you like, or stop the session from either place.

options.hint: The same options as in the floating window: changes show there at once.

sync.title: The shared tab, in step with the captions
sync.hint: Watch the video here, not in the original tab: its sound comes from here a few seconds behind, and each caption lands on its sentence. It is a copy of the tab: the original player’s buttons do not respond, use these. Shortcuts: Space or K pauses, F fullscreen, C captions.
sync.failed: The picture could not be played behind time in this browser.
sync.delayHint: How far the picture is held back. If captions often come late, raise it

live.demoStarted: Free demo: 3 minutes of translated captions. Add your own key to keep going.

consent.text: You will translate other people's speech: make sure they agree. The audio and text are sent to OpenAI with your key.

view.audioBilled: Audio billed: {sent} of {heard} heard; the silence stayed on your device.
view.speaker: Voice {n}

settingsPage.title: Settings
settingsPage.intro: Saved in this browser and used for the next session. During a session the bar’s menu has them too, in the page or the floating window.

general.title: Language and look
general.translateHint: The language captions and voice are translated into. The bar can change it during a session too.
general.uiLanguageHint: The language of the app’s menus and buttons.
general.themeHint: Light, dark or whatever your system uses.

backup.title: Backup
backup.hint: Save your settings to a file to take them to another browser or get them back later. The key is never included.
backup.exported: Settings saved to your downloads folder.
backup.exportFailed: The browser did not let the file be saved. Try again.

errors.tooLarge: That file is too large to be a settings backup.
errors.unreadable: That file could not be read.
errors.notOurs: That file is not a @:{'brand.name'} settings backup.
errors.newer: That backup comes from a newer version. Reload the page and try again.
